parameters.name: ExpireTime
parameters.description: The expiration time of the API key in ISO-8601 format. The value must be later than the current time.

parameters.name: GatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the AI gateway instance.

parameters.name: KeyCount
parameters.description: The number of API keys to generate (the number of capacity plans to order). Valid values: 1 to 30.

parameters.name: PackageSpec
parameters.description: The number of credits per API key. The value is a positive integer string.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.
> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query region information.
